envelope.description: Integration tests over the real file system and the chat panel, and the real migration

body.title: Integration tests over the real file system and the chat panel, and the real migration
body.summary: Tests, plus one reported check. Over a real temporary directory, two store instances on one session each append, the first saves its held object twice more with a get between, and a hand-written torn last line is dropped and cut back. The chat panel run over the file store: a turn's saves append only that turn's rows, a restored session shows the same rows, and a failing save is logged without breaking the turn. A session the migration kept in globalState keeps its output files through the start-up sweep. Any defect these expose in the code of t2 to t5 is fixed here. Last, the builder installs the build and reports what the real migration did on the user's machine; the gate cannot run that, so it is recorded as reported.
acceptanceChecks: Over a real directory the rows file holds every row of both store instances, was never replaced, and a torn last line is dropped and cut back
Under the chat panel a turn's saves append only that turn's rows, a restored session shows the same rows, and a failing save is logged without breaking the turn
A session kept by the migration keeps its output files through the sweep
The whole plugin test suite passes apart from the two manifest-catalog tests that failed before this Story

Reported by the builder after installing the build and the user reloading the window: the existing chats open with their history, ~/.insrc/chat-sessions holds a head and a rows file for each, and the extension's value in state.vscdb no longer holds the sessions
